ErrorCode.description: Stable error categories. Clients branch on the code, never on the message.

oneOf.description:
The request is not the caller's to make: the credential is unknown or
revoked, the caller is not the owner, administrator, assignee or member
the request is for, a daemon-wide grant is missing, the caller is a
viewer and the request is not read-only, or the inviter refused an
invitation.

The named thing does not exist, or is in a goal the caller is not
part of.

The request is malformed, or needs something the connection lacks: a
session for a claim-bound request, a principal for the owner.

A precondition no longer holds, for example a stale base, a task
already reassigned or a name already taken.
Another session holds the claim.
The caller's claim, generation, attempt or attempt is not current.
The idempotency key was already used for a different request.
The request exceeds a published or configured limit.
Needed content or a needed peer is not reachable now.

The goal's authority history conflicts, so nothing more is signed for
it; see [`Halt::AuthorityConflict`].

The client, a ticket or an event uses a version this daemon does not
speak.
Local state failed an integrity check.

The daemon failed: storage, or a fault of its own. Not the caller's
doing, and retrying the same request may succeed.

The request is the caller's to make and will be allowed once the
local participant authorizes it: a claim, takeover or decision that no
goal grant covers. The owner answers with `task.authorize`, with
`goal.grant`, or by making the request on the principal's behalf.

This daemon's signer for the goal is in restore recovery and signs
nothing; see [`Halt::SignerRecovery`]. Reads still work.

error_schema.description: Why a request was refused. `Display` is `<code>: <message>`.

details_json.description: Structured correction details encoded as JSON for wire-safe transport.

message.description: For people. Written by the daemon; never contains peer-written text.

error_schema.title: ApiError

round.description: RulesBound for goal/document scopes; TaskOpened/TaskRevised/effect for tasks.

object.description: Sealed canonical JSON source; semantic identity is independently checked.

Effect.description:
Witness lists do not change logical identity. The evaluator verifies that
the resolved action is the exact configured consequence of this trigger.

stage.description: Only configured materialization may set this stage identity.

closure.description:
Exact observed position in this round's closure stream. None means
no position has been observed; concurrent offline starts remain valid.

operations.name: context.read
operations.summary: Read a coherent goal or task brief with attributed findings, progress, review reasons and pending actions; reads do not acknowledge content

operations.name: context.acknowledge
operations.summary: Acknowledge the complete content delivered to this execution session using its exact receipt; other sessions remain unread

operations.name: invitation.inspect
operations.summary: Verify a signed invitation and preview its issuer, goal and sharing boundary without joining

operations.name: invitation.list
operations.summary: List issued invitations and their current redemption, expiry or revocation state without revealing ticket secrets

operations.name: invitation.revoke
operations.summary: Revoke an issued invitation; existing membership remains a separate decision

operations.name: invitation.join
operations.summary: Join as the selected enrolled principal after reviewing this exact signed invitation; grants remain unchanged

operations.name: permission.inspect
operations.summary: Inspect an enrolled principal's explicit local permissions and membership

operations.name: permission.allow
operations.summary: Allow only the selected local goal permissions for an enrolled principal

operations.name: permission.task.allow
operations.summary: Allow local execution for this task, preserving existing takeover permission

operations.name: permission.task.revoke
operations.summary: Remove every local execution authorization for this agent and task; running processes are not terminated

operations.name: permission.revoke
operations.summary: Revoke only the selected local goal permissions; this does not terminate a running process

operations.name: inbox
operations.summary: Show local participants and work needing permission, action or review across goals without acknowledging it

ContextCursor.description:
A continuation for exactly one observed revision and query. If the goal
changes, restart the read; pages from different revisions are never joined.
Session acknowledgments do not change this revision. The offset addresses
relevant events before unread filtering, so acknowledging each page is safe.

ContextReceipt.description:
A daemon-signed receipt bound to the hello session. Only complete, available
event texts are listed. Missing or previewed text cannot be acknowledged.
Receipts survive daemon restart and remain valid after unrelated changes.

ContextSeen.description: One immutable event version delivered with its entire text.

version.description: Binds the event's current standing, local feed position and payload availability.

GoalGrants.description: Explicit local authorization; shared blueprint eligibility never grants it.

GoalPermission.description:
Independent local permission categories. Membership and organization roles
remain separate conditions for an operation to be effective.

Grants.description:
What the local participant has authorized a principal to do on this
daemon without asking again.

manage_goals.description: Create goals, issue invitations, join and leave.

SessionCapabilities.description:
What a session's client and adapter support, each reported on its own.
None is inferred from another.

active_delivery.description: Pending work can be surfaced while the session is active.

confinement.description:
The whole client process tree runs under a participant-selected
supervisor.

idle_wake.description: An idle session can be woken.

manual_resume.description: The session can be resumed by an explicit local action.

recovery.description: The session can be recovered after an interruption.

SessionRecord.description:
What an adapter records about one client session. Typed where the daemon
or the owner reads it; `detail` is the adapter's own.

capabilities.description: What the client and adapter support in this session.

client.description:
The client and its version as the adapter reports them, for example
`claude-code 2.1.0`. At most [`MAX_LOCAL_TEXT_BYTES`].

client_session.description:
The client's own identifier for the session, used to resume it. It
proves nothing to the daemon. At most [`MAX_LOCAL_TEXT_BYTES`].

detail.description:
Opaque to the daemon: encoded and owned by `locust-adapter`. At most
[`MAX_SESSION_DETAIL_BYTES`].

state.description: How far the session has come.

SessionState.description: How far a client session has come, as its adapter observed it.

oneOf.description: The launch intent is recorded; the client process is not started yet.
The client process exists. Nothing is known about its readiness.
The client is initialized and its tools or hooks answer.
The client waits for the user: an approval, a sign-in, a prompt.

WorkspaceBinding.description:
Where one local principal's files for a goal live and how far they have
come. Local and never replicated. The daemon stores the strings verbatim
and never opens the paths; the workspace code in the CLI or adapter reads
and writes them. Each string is at most [`MAX_LOCAL_TEXT_BYTES`].

destination.description: The separate directory that received snapshots are materialized into.

export_root.description: The directory the participant chose to share from.

integrated.description: Last artifact explicitly applied locally; no goal-wide selection implication.

source_commit.description:
The Git commit the last export was taken from. Provenance only: the
exported manifest, not the commit, identifies what was shared.

request_schema.description: Current greenfield API. Blueprint rules and local grants are separate.
request_schema.title: Request

agent.description: The principal's key; the daemon holds the signing half.

grants.description: Its daemon-wide grants. Per-goal grants are in [`GoalStatus`].

revoked.description: True once the credential was revoked. The name stays taken.

AttentionEntry.description:
An owner's view of a local principal's obligations. Reading does not claim,
acknowledge, consume a context cursor, or authorize anything.

BlobState.description: Whether the daemon can serve a content object of a goal.

oneOf.description: Held here; [`Request::BlobGet`] returns it.
Not held; the daemon has noted the want and is asking peers.
Not obtainable now: withdrawn here, or no reachable peer holds it.
Nothing in this goal names the hash.

BlobStatus.description: One content object of a goal and whether the daemon can serve it.

hash.description: Hash of the stored, sealed object.

state.description: Whether it can be served now.

closure.description:
Exact observed position in this round's closure stream. None means
no position has been observed; concurrent offline starts remain valid.

round.description: RulesBound for goal/document scopes; TaskOpened/TaskRevised/effect for tasks.

ContextAcknowledgment.description:
Durable local acknowledgment of these exact event versions. Repeating a
receipt returns the same acknowledgment and cannot consume later versions.

ContextCursor.description:
A continuation for exactly one observed revision and query. If the goal
changes, restart the read; pages from different revisions are never joined.
Session acknowledgments do not change this revision. The offset addresses
relevant events before unread filtering, so acknowledging each page is safe.

ContextDocument.description:
Current document selection and candidates; the attributed text and reviews
are in the paginated items, including in task-specific context.

acknowledged.description: None for an observer without a session. Never principal-wide.

text_complete.description:
False for missing text or an explicitly requested preview. Read again
with preview_chars omitted for full text; the same event remains unread.

ContextNews.description: News for this execution session at a normal pending-work checkpoint.

unavailable.description: Included in unacknowledged; text is not currently readable here.

ContextReceipt.description:
A daemon-signed receipt bound to the hello session. Only complete, available
event texts are listed. Missing or previewed text cannot be acknowledged.
Receipts survive daemon restart and remain valid after unrelated changes.

ContextSeen.description: One immutable event version delivered with its entire text.

version.description: Binds the event's current standing, local feed position and payload availability.

effective_rules_json.description: The requested scope's pinned rules, including a task's type.

inputs.description: Named inputs of the requested goal or task scope.

pending.description: Goal-wide obligations from the same observation as all other fields.

receipt.description:
None for owner/viewer observation without an acting execution session,
or when no complete, available items were delivered on this page.

DaemonStatus.description:
What `status` shows: the daemon, and as much of its principals and goals
as the caller may see.

agents.description:
Every enrolled principal for the owner; only the calling principal
for an agent or a viewer.

daemon_version.description: The daemon's own version, for people.

endpoint.description: Absent until the transport is running.

goals.description:
One entry per goal and local principal in it: all of them for the
owner, only the calling principal's own for an agent or a viewer.

object.description: Sealed canonical JSON source; semantic identity is independently checked.

available.description: False when the effect or recipient no longer has effective authority.

received.description: The local daemon durably holds this recipient inbox item.

DocView.description: A shared document: its selected revision and retained proposals.

proposals.description:
Revisions proposed against the selected one. Read
one with [`Request::Event`].

text.description: Text of the selected revision; absent when it is not held locally.

source.description: Exact authored bytes as UTF-8, including whitespace and incomplete JSON.

Effect.description:
Witness lists do not change logical identity. The evaluator verifies that
the resolved action is the exact configured consequence of this trigger.

EventDetail.description:
One event in full: everything a administrator needs to judge a submitted
result or a proposed revision before deciding on it.

anchor.description: The decision the event anchors to; absent only on genesis.

body.description:
The signed, typed content: for a result its attempt, base, patch
and artifacts; for a revision its document and base.

content.description:
Every content object the event names, in the order of
[`Header::blobs`](crate::event::Header::blobs) (payload first), with
whether it is held.

payload.description: Names the event's text, if it has any.

task.description:
The task the event concerns, resolved through its attempt, result
or cancellation; absent for events that concern no task.

text.description:
The payload as text: a result's summary, a revision's text. Absent
when there is no payload or it is not held locally.

view.description: The event's feed entry: identifier, author, kind and standing.

EventView.description:
One event as the feed lists it: who wrote what kind of event, and how it
stands. The content is read with [`Request::Event`].

author.description: The principal whose key signed it.

position.description:
Position in the goal's feed. The feed numbers events from 1 in the
order they took effect here: the order this daemon applied them, as
`Effective` or as `Excluded`. A `Pending` event has no position yet.
Feed positions are local to this daemon and are not storage log
positions, which follow arrival.

standing.description: How the event stands in the goal's replicated state.

GoalGrants.description: Explicit local authorization; shared blueprint eligibility never grants it.

name.description: Local display label; the public key identifies the principal.

GoalSummary.description: One local principal's part in one goal, as `status` lists it.

goal.description: The goal this entry is about.

halted.description: Set while the goal's decisions cannot advance here.

member.description: The local principal this entry is about.

membership.description: How that principal stands in the goal.

title.description: Absent until the goal's founding text is held locally.

Grants.description:
What the local participant has authorized a principal to do on this
daemon without asking again.

manage_goals.description: Create goals, issue invitations, join and leave.

Halt.description: Why a goal's decisions cannot advance on this daemon.

oneOf.description:
The authority's history conflicts with itself. The goal stays
readable and exportable; requests that sign fail with
[`ErrorCode::Halted`].

This daemon's signer for the goal is in restore recovery: it cannot
yet show what it already signed, so it signs nothing. Requests that
sign fail with [`ErrorCode::ReadOnly`].

InvitationPreview.description:
Authenticated ticket facts, without the bearer capability. Signature
verification attributes the presentation to a key, not a human identity.

admission_status.description: Inspection is offline; it does not promise admission or contact an issuer.

review.description: Digest of this complete signed invitation; confirmation must echo it.

InvitationSharing.description:
The sharing boundary signed into every invitation. A topic or role is
never a confidential subset of a goal.

InvitationSummary.description:
Issuer-local inventory. The identifier is a one-way capability digest;
none of these fields can redeem an invitation.

MemberView.description: One current member of a goal.

endpoint.description: The daemon its admission bound it to.

local.description: True for principals this daemon holds keys for.

Membership.description: How a local principal stands in a goal.

oneOf.description:
An invitation was redeemed here; the administrator's admission has not
arrived yet.
Admitted and taking part.

The administrator removed the principal. History stays readable;
nothing new is authored.
The principal asked to leave and no longer takes part.

The administrator refused this local join attempt. No goal content is
readable until a subsequent invitation is admitted.

PeerView.description: What this daemon knows about reaching one peer of a goal.

connected.description: True while a link to the peer is up.

last_sync_ms.description:
Last successful synchronization, Unix milliseconds by the local clock.
State written by the peer after this is unknown here.

context_news.description: Shared content not yet acknowledged by this execution session.

data_json.description: Opaque JSON layout metadata; never included in semantic identity.

What a session's client and adapter support, each reported on its own.

active_delivery.description: Pending work can be surfaced while the session is active.

confinement.description:
The whole client process tree runs under a participant-selected
supervisor.

idle_wake.description: An idle session can be woken.

One session as the daemon holds it: its record, and what the daemon

attached.description: True while a connection that presented this session's secret is open.

claims.description: Claims the session holds on unfinished attempts, in any goal.

principal.description: The principal the session belongs to.

record.description: What the session's adapter last reported.

updated_ms.description:
When the record was last written, Unix milliseconds by the daemon's
clock.

Standing.description: How an event stands in the goal's replicated state.

oneOf.description: Authorized and applied: its transition took effect.

Held, but something it depends on has not arrived, so it has not been
judged yet.

Kept as attributed evidence; it grants nothing. Its author was not
entitled to it, the transition was not allowed, or it belongs to a
conflicting history.
Retained evidence whose authority proof conflicts within its exact scope.

stage.description: Only configured materialization may set this stage identity.

oneOf.description:
The goal changed since the revision the caller had seen. The lists
may be empty when the change needs nothing from the caller; the feed
and the board show what happened.
The timeout passed and nothing changed.

The timeout passed, nothing changed, and no peer of this goal is
currently reachable, so remote changes cannot arrive.

response_schema.description:
What a request answers with when it succeeds; which variant answers which
request is [`Request::is_answered_by`]. No response ever carries a secret.

oneOf.description: The request succeeded and has nothing to return.
Answers `status`.

Answers `agent.enroll`. Carries no credential: the client already has
the one it enrolled.

agent.description: The new principal's key, generated and held by the daemon.

oneOf.description: Answers `goal.create`.

goal.description: The new goal: the digest of its genesis record.

oneOf.description: Answers `goal.invite`.

ticket.description: The text to hand to the invitee. It is the capability.

oneOf.description:
What the caller joined, as the ticket named it. `membership` is
`Joining` until the administrator's admission has arrived.

administrator.description: The administrator's key, to show as a fingerprint.

oneOf.description: Answers `goal.status`.
Answers `board`: every task of the goal.
Answers `task.show`.
Answers `event.show`.

The request was signed and recorded as this event, which identifies

note or a revision.

Answers `attempt.start` and `attempt.takeover` with the claim the calling
session now holds.
Answers `pending`.
Answers `wait`.
